role: End-user manual describing every tab, screen, setting, metric, the Flo assistant, workouts, Get Me Back, Watch companion, privacy and troubleshooting, with concrete thresholds and defaults.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual
units.does: no behavioural claim: manual title.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Overview
units.does: Claims three functions: overnight recovery from Polar H10/Verity Sense RR, workouts (10 sports listed) with GPS/Watch/strap HR and Stryd/FTMS/PM5 power, and Flo answering on-device or with the user's API key; integrates HealthKit; not a medical device.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > App Navigation
units.does: Claims a 5-tab layout (Dashboard, Record, Fitness, Flo, More) with Trends/Settings/Help/About under More, History via Dashboard View all; Fitness tab hideable, Flo can be turned off on next launch, collapsing to 3 tabs; Watch app embedded and WatchConnectivity on by default.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > App Navigation > Naming
units.does: Claims Flo = chat, Coach = mid-workout voice ('Coach here'), Flo Report = email. Matches AssistantSubsystem.voiceAnnouncement (AIProvider.swift:144-151).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for the Dashboard tab.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Recovery Score Card
units.does: Claims: 0-100 score using ln(RMSSD) z-scores against the last 60 recorded nights; HRV 60 / Sleep 25 / Vitals 15 with Tier 1/2/3; SpO2 below 95% applies -10; score timing nights 3/7/14; pips 0-13 / 14-27 / 28+; readiness modulation (at most 55% excess kept, 30% of gap given back); Comeback mode HRV 80 / Sleep 20 / Vitals 0 for 21 days; verdict bands 90/75/60/45/30. Verified: BaselineTracker uses the last 60 stored nights (BaselineTracker.swift:210-213) with minimumDays 3; ScoreVerdict.init bands (ScoreVerdict.swift:30-38); ConfidencePip 14/28 thresholds; RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:7-15 weights and comeback; ReadinessScoring trust 0.55 (ReadinessScoring.swift:89).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Today's Loop
units.does: Claims a one-sentence 'Today's Loop' line under the score that becomes tappable when readiness changed.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Feeling Chip
units.does: Claims a feeling chip showing the morning feeling or 'Tap how you feel', editable, saved on the night's session.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > HRV / Sleep / Vitals / Load Chips
units.does: Claims four chips HRV/Sleep/Vitals/Load each opening a detail view; Load hidden when Fitness tab hidden or training load paused.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Recent Strip
units.does: Claims a 7-day Recent strip; View all opens History; verdict words appear after 30 nights of baseline.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Multi-Segment Recovery
units.does: Claims paused/resumed or same-night sessions within the merge window are combined for window selection and scoring.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Estimated Sleep When Apple Health Has None
units.does: Claims that with no Apple Health sleep the app estimates sleep from the overnight HR drop (strap RR first, then Watch HR), automatically when morning results open, only for nights with no sleep.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Morning Feeling Badge
units.does: Claims a 1-5 pre-score feeling prompt shown before the score, optional tags for ratings 1-2, editable later, and divergence detection when self-rating differs from HRV by more than one category.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Dashboard Toolbar (top-right)
units.does: Claims three toolbar icons: Notifications, Send Report menu (recovery/daily/workout PDF rendered off the main actor into the mail composer, Browse all reports) and Ask Flo shortcuts that auto-send and switch to Flo.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Dashboard Tab > Before Your First Reading
units.does: Claims a Get started checklist (Pair device, Connect Apple Health, Take your first reading) replaces chips and strip with no readings; its Take your first reading row (firstReadingRow -> onStartRecording) opens the Record tab.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for detail views.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > HRV Detail View
units.does: Claims HRV detail hero label from ln(RMSSD) vs baseline, falling back to absolute RMSSD 60/45/30 ms bands; HR strip, autonomic capacity, trends vs 30-day average, waveform, Poincaré, beat consistency, advanced tabs; artifact banner above 10% corrected beats.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Sleep Detail View
units.does: Claims a sleep score with weights Duration 25 / Efficiency 20 / Stages 20 (deep 10, REM 10) / Fragmentation 15 / Cycles 10 / Architecture 10, short-night cap 90 → 60, stage source Watch or estimated from chest strap RR, vitals grid, quality and insight cards.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Sleep Detail View > Adjust Sleep Screen
units.does: Describes SleepTimelineEditorView opened from Adjust (adjustSleepButton) or Edit sleep (editSleepButton): one timeline of segments, tap to select, drag handles (no crossing a neighbour, 1-minute snap), Split with preview / Carve Awake / Merge / Delete, long-press to add stage-less sleep, live stage pills, TOTAL SLEEP with a signed delta, Undo (5 steps), Reset, Refresh from Apple Health; Done saves and rescores, Cancel discards; opening the app does not rewrite history.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Training Detail View
units.does: Claims ACR card and labels <0.8 Below usual, 0.8-1.0 Maintenance, 1.0-1.3 In range, 1.3-1.5 Above usual, >1.5 Sharp increase; Foster monotony/strain banner; recent workouts with TRIMP.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detail Views > Vitals Detail View
units.does: Claims vitals detail with status banner, score card, expandable RHR / respiratory rate (7-day baseline) / SpO2 / wrist temperature cards.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > First Launch (Onboarding)
units.does: Claims a mandatory device-local Health Disclaimer gate, then a 7-page onboarding (Welcome, What Emuqu does, Profile, Sensor, Apple Health, Backup, You're In) with pages 1-6 skippable and onboarding reappearing if killed before page 7.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > First Launch (Onboarding) > What onboarding does NOT capture (set these later in Settings)
units.does: Claims fallbacks: max HR 208 − 0.7 × age (Tanaka), LTHR 0.88 × max HR, body weight 75 kg, units follow region. Verified UserSettings+Model.swift:85 (75.0), :121 (0.88), :286 (Tanaka, else 180).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for the Record tab.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Session Type Selection
units.does: Claims session-first flow with Extended (default) and Quick Reading (2/3/5 min).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Connection Section
units.does: Claims known-device list with swipe/long-press removal, scanning list with dBm, connected device panel (battery, Verity ~30 h estimate, firmware, H10 memory), and battery gating: <10% disables recording, 10-20% advisory. Verified RecordView+Actions.swift:14 (battery < 10) and :19 (10..<20).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Tag Selection
units.does: Claims a horizontal system-tag row with More opening the full tag picker.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Extended Recording (Overnight / Multi-Hour)
units.does: Claims extended recording flow: Morning tag auto-added when ending 4-10 AM; pause runs a full analysis and saves; Continue Recovery card within merge window; auto-finalize at strap battery <= 5% while paused; best 5-minute window; report opens automatically; H10 upload refines score; Verity disconnects. Verified Morning-tag hour gate 4..<10 (RecordView+Results.swift:176).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Quick Reading Section (Spot Check)
units.does: Claims quick reading 2/3/5 min with countdown, progress ring, breathing mandala, voice guide, Stop Early, and a Reading Complete card.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Data Quality Verification
units.does: Claims verification shows quality badge, window duration, quality %, artifact % (<10% good), clean beats (200+ good). Verified artifactPercent < 10 check (RecordVerificationSection.swift:54).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Results Preview
units.does: Claims extended results open the full report with Done/Discard and an upward arrow when H10 data improved the score; quick readings show Reading Complete.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Record Tab > Data Recovery
units.does: Claims device-memory recovery alerts (Recover Data / Discard & Start Fresh / Retry Fetch) and, after a crash mid-recording, a launch 'Session Interrupted' alert with Resume, Save as Complete (Save to Archive when not resumable) and Dismiss, where Dismiss only stops the alert for that session and the backup stays recoverable from Settings → iCloud & Data → Recover Lost Sessions.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant)
units.does: Claims Flo chats with one of six providers; every message carries the current time and training-load headline; Apple Intelligence also gets the rendered recovery context (today, yesterday, 14 days, baselines, 7/30-day trends, morning feeling) via compactRender; a cloud model gets only the today/yesterday live-state block (AssistantContext.renderLiveStateForCloud, plus location during a live workout) and fetches the rest with tools.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Adaptive Routing — Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual
units.does: Claims routing acts only with Apple Intelligence selected and that with Apple there is no text field (suggestion chips or voice only; ChatInputBar.appleOnlyComposerHint), voice skipping tiers, so the modes route chip questions; Quick answers on Apple; Auto classifies four capability axes (keyword AND embedding >= 0.55) and sends flagged turns to consented Grok then DeepSeek; 3 settling turns then sticky-up unless zero flags; after 50 cloud Deep turns a day further Deep turns are marked Auto, which with Apple selected maps to the same Grok/DeepSeek model so the cap does not reduce cloud use; Deep uses the same consented model; voice and action requests go to the first consented cloud; earcon; 14-pattern deterministic catalog; tier dot; AFM prewarm 'during init'; cache-health card.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > First Use
units.does: Claims a one-time disclaimer covering on-device Apple, connected-model data sharing, reply filtering (diagnostic/offensive sentence removal, number correction) and Report response by email; accepted once.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Choosing a Provider
units.does: Claims a model picker listing Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+), Claude Haiku 4.5/Sonnet 4.6/Opus 4.7, ChatGPT GPT-6 Luna/GPT-5.4 mini/GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite/3.8 Flash/3.1 Pro Preview, Grok 4.3/4.7, DeepSeek Flash/V4 Pro; Set up Flo screen when nothing can answer; keys in device-only Keychain. Verified display names in Providers/*.swift and APIKeyStore ThisDeviceOnly accessibility.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > The Chat Screen
units.does: Claims chat screen: model chip, Stop, ⋯ menu, voice toggle top-left, 10 pre-fab chips, input row only for paid models (Apple path shows a caption instead), typing indicator, markdown streaming, auto-scroll. Verified 10 PrefabQuestion cases and the Apple-only composer hint (AssistantChatSupport.swift:125-145).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > How the assistant fetches your data (tool use)
units.does: Claims every provider uses tool use, prompt is small and cache-stable, hard cap 8 tool calls per question, Apple transcript trimmed verbatim at 70% of 4K keeping the latest user turn, Apple session cache rotates after 20 turns.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > What the AI can do beyond reading your data
units.does: Claims [ACTION] tools for saved routes, navigation (walking route, <10 ms follow-ups, 'never mind' clears), location, email draft + contacts, memory, web search; read-back of results and verbatim disambiguation.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Where am I / what's nearby
units.does: Claims location answers from a warm resolved-address cache (workout pipeline or ambient service when foregrounded) including nearest cross street; verbal forward-geocoding fallback.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Where am I / what's nearby > `location_situation` — one-call situational awareness
units.does: Claims location_situation bundles address, heading/speed, POIs in five categories (empty vs failed distinguished), next turn, journey block from JourneyIntelligenceService and recurrence from RecurrenceClassifier (100 m start rounding, 75 m mean offset, >= 2 prior trails). Verified startCoordRoundingMeters 100 (RecurrenceClassifier.swift:86) and 75 m default.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Where am I / what's nearby > `location_roads_ahead` — forward-looking road awareness
units.does: Claims location_roads_ahead returns the next 1-3 intersections; a confidence below 0.4 or nil phrase forces 'I don't have road data'. Verified confidence >= 0.4 && phrase != nil gate (AppFactResolver+LiveNavigation.swift:92).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Training-load projections — composable AI primitives
units.does: Claims projection primitives training.load.snapshot, training.project_from, training.days_until_converged_from (notRecorded beyond 60 days), training.projected_tsb. Verified patterns exist and the 60-day unmet message (AppFactResolver+TrainingProjections.swift:296).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Pre-fab Questions
units.does: Lists the 10 pre-fab chips and what each asks. Matches PrefabQuestion cases (PrefabQuestions.swift:29-58).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Voice Input — two modes
units.does: Claims dictation uses on-device recognition (requiresOnDeviceRecognition = true), Settings → Flo → Speech recognizer chooses Apple Speech or WhisperKit (English only, ~100 MB download) for voice mode; voice replies limited to 1-3 sentences. Verified SpeechInputManager.swift:71.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Voice Input — two modes > Interrupting the AI
units.does: Claims interrupt needs at least two words, sustained noise alone never triggers, mic button and Stop both kill LLM and TTS, Send now force-commits.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Voice Input — two modes > Known voice limitations
units.does: Claims AirPods recommended, whispers below ~-40 dBFS do not register, system interruptions tear voice down without auto-resume.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Long-Press Any Message
units.does: Claims long-press menu: Remember this, Copy, Regenerate (last assistant message only).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Web Search (optional, opt-in)
units.does: Claims opt-in Tavily web search (key in Keychain, toggle), curated research/manufacturer whitelists and excluded sites, with Anthropic running its own search on Claude; prompt rules on citing and one search per turn. Domain lists match WebSearchService.swift:39-97.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Cross-Session Memory ("What the AI Remembers")
units.does: Claims persistent memory facts injected into every conversation, added manually, via Remember this, or via Auto-remember (off by default); stored on device only.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Tappable Date Citations
units.does: Claims dates matching an archived session render as tappable links opening a read-only quick view.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Switching Models Mid-Conversation
units.does: Claims history carries across provider switches, truncated to each model's budget with an auto-summary.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Long Conversations
units.does: Claims older turns are dropped from the send window and replaced with an auto-summary; Clear conversation starts fresh.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Keyboard Dismissal
units.does: no behavioural claim: keyboard dismissal gestures.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Cost Notes (Connected Models)
units.does: Claims no in-app cost display; Anthropic prompt caching makes sends within ~5 minutes reuse the cached system prompt at ~10% cost; others cache server-side.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Flo Tab (the AI Assistant) > Known Limitations
units.does: Claims known limitations: Apple safety refusals, cold start, 4K window, no monthly/yearly aggregation tools, fabrication risk, unpinned non-Claude model IDs, single thread, citation picks latest session of a day, voice MVP.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History
units.does: Claims History opens from Dashboard View all and lists sessions from in-memory metadata.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Session Type Filter
units.does: Claims type filter chips All / Extended / Naps / Quick / Breathe. Verified five chips (HistoryView.swift:473-492).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Tag Filter
units.does: Claims a tag filter row with OR semantics across selected tags.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Search
units.does: Claims search by date, tag name or notes.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Session List
units.does: Claims pagination 10 at a time grouped Today/Yesterday/This Week/Last Week/Month Year, with row contents incl. recovery score on the dashboard verdict ladder.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Swipe Actions
units.does: Claims swipe-left Delete and swipe-right Edit Tags.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Long-Press a Row
units.does: Claims long-press 'Ask Flo about this session' pre-fills a question for sessions in the last ~30 days.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Tap Session
units.does: Claims tapping a session opens MorningResultsView in a sheet.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > History > Empty State
units.does: Claims empty state with Clear Filters when filtering.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Trends
units.does: Claims Trends (More → Trends) over overnight readings only: tag chips, 7/14/30/90/All ranges, overall trend, metric chart with ±1 SD band once 4 overnight readings in the last 60 days, stats grid, insights needing >= 3 readings, training-load calendar whose day sheet lists that day's readings with headline numbers, deletes by long-press and opens nothing (open from History); an overnight sits on its wake morning.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView)
units.does: no behavioural claim: heading for MorningResultsView.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Header Section
units.does: Claims header with quality badge Excellent if artifact <5% else Good, beat count, window info.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Key Metrics Section
units.does: Claims the report's half-width HRV card (beside the Sleep card) shows RMSSD with Excellent/Good/Fair/Reduced/Low from AppTheme.hrvCategory against the scoring baseline, falling back to age- and sex-adjusted bands without one, and navigates to SessionHRVDetailView, which uses the same baseline label plus HR stats; the Sleep card opens Sleep detail.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Readiness Section
units.does: Claims a Recovery Readiness gauge on a 0-10 scale.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Training Load Section
units.does: Claims a training-load section only when data exists (ACR gauge, ATL/CTL/TRIMP, recent workouts).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Analysis Summary Section
units.does: Claims a generated analysis summary paragraph.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Analysis Window
units.does: Claims window method picker (Best Recovery default, Highest RMSSD/SDNN, Highest Total Power using SDNN so it picks the Highest SDNN window) re-running this night's analysis; the pick is stored as settings.defaultWindowSelectionMethod, seeds every later report's picker (MorningResultsViewModel.init) and the Dashboard re-analyze (refreshDashboard), while new recordings always use Best Recovery; manual Choose Window mode with Auto/Yours/Diff compare banner; Apply replaces the night's analysis while keeping the auto pick.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Peak Capacity Section
units.does: Claims a Peak Capacity card with the highest sustained 5-minute HRV period.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Session Charts Section
units.does: Claims context-dependent chart titles, HRV chart first with pinned cursor and Analyze Here, HR chart with sleep stage overlay.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Tags Section
units.does: Claims tags editable on the report.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Notes Section
units.does: Claims notes and tag changes are saved on Done or when the report closes, swipe included (saveTagsAndNotesIfChanged from the Done button and .onDisappear, only when they differ from what was last stored).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Detailed Report View (MorningResultsView) > Action Buttons
units.does: Claims Email Report builds a PDF with selectable sections (Metrics & Data, Visualizations for raw-RR sessions, Analysis Summary); Delete from History confirms then moves the reading to the Trash, restorable from Settings → iCloud & Data → Trash for 90 days (ArchiveStore.moveToTrash, expiredDeletionIds keepDays 90); Reanalyze.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab
units.does: no behavioural claim: Fitness tab overview.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Fitness tab dashboard
units.does: Claims a hero card for the latest workout (sport badge, distance, polyline, badge row), 7/30-day tiles, passive activity card, Get Me Back card, recent list.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Get Me Back mode
units.does: Claims Get Me Back captures fixes every 30 s or 25 m, hides the arrow above 100 m accuracy, saves atomically per fix; SOS dials 911 (NA + PH), 999/000/111/119/120/193 elsewhere, else 112; Clear offers keep/end-save/discard; workout trails auto-archived, up to 50 kept. Verified timeCommitSeconds 30 and movementCommitMeters 25 (BreadcrumbRecorder.swift:69-73), accuracy cap 100 m (:226), archiveRetentionLimit 50 (BreadcrumbStore.swift:155), emergencyNumber switch (GetMeBackView.swift:743-752).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Starting a workout
units.does: Claims Start auto-reconnects the paired strap and Stryd, strap stays ~120 s for HRR then disconnects; sport list; HR source automatic (strap when connected or paired, else Watch; WorkoutPlanModel.resolvedSource); target zone with no spoken drift nudge (zone.drifted rules are .silent); interval plans; ambient-coach thresholds in plain words (HR bpm, %FTP, elevation gain, grade, elapsed time, distance per WorkoutThreshold.parsePlainText) with debounce/cooldown; route binding via trail discovery (2-50 km radius), GPX, or saved-route recognition after ~500 m.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Live road context
units.does: Claims reverse geocoding after ~15 m or 60 s, backing off to every 30 s after 8 consecutive failures; never fabricates a street. Verified movementThresholdMeters 15 and timeThresholdSec 60 (RoadGeocodingService.swift:92-96).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Power meters
units.does: Claims Stryd over Cycling Power + RSC at 1 Hz, FTMS trainers, PM5; running/cycling FTP set separately; every power workout records average/peak power, NP and VI (applyPowerAggregates), IF and power load only with an FTP (applyFTPAnchoredMetrics), no set-FTP prompt; post-summary LOAD tile shows power load when present with an HRSS tile beside it; NP shown in the History calendar row; IF and VI shown nowhere, read by Flo.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > My Routes (route library + route-aware coaching)
units.does: Claims post-summary 'Add to my route library', management in Settings → My Routes, direction-agnostic recognition after ~500 m giving the coach climbs, ascent remaining, peak, steepest grade.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Live weather context
units.does: Claims MET Norway weather with location rounded to ~1 km, refreshed ~30 min (never more than every 10 min), saved at workout end for heat tracking. Verified WeatherService.cacheTTL 30*60 (WeatherService.swift:45).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Zwift / TrainerRoad / Rouvy broadcaster
units.does: Claims enableZwiftBroadcast (Settings → Wearables, first-enable explainer) advertises HR + Cycling Power services; off by default.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > During a workout (live view)
units.does: Claims live tiles update each second; α1 tile explains unavailability; power/METs tiles when live; live map.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Voice coach
units.does: Claims the voice coach evaluates a rule engine each tick; only user-added thresholds (user.threshold.breach, .spoken) are voiced; α1, HR drift, zone drift, climb-ahead and strap-down rules are .silent/.haptic and WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch drops them, so a dropped strap is not announced; a full live snapshot is available to the AI.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Post-workout summary
units.does: Claims the summary opens instantly with HRR captured over 120 s; lists cards (map, stats, HRR, charts, α1 timeline with AT1 0.75 / AT2 0.50, route by α1, α1 LT1 ±10 bpm, crossings, zone distribution on configured max HR, derived metrics, decoupling/EF, splits, GPX/CSV/TCX export).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Training load — how TRIMP and HRSS are computed
units.does: Claims TRIMP = Banister with A=0.64,k=1.92 (male) / A=0.86,k=1.67 (female) on heart-rate reserve; HRSS = TRIMP / TRIMP(1 h at LTHR) × 100; LTHR default 0.88 × max HR; resting HR order user → baseline → 60 bpm. Verified WorkoutAnalyzer.banisterTRIMP/beatTRIMP (WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:240-280) via TrainingConstants.TRIMP; Edwards fallback when max/rest HR missing.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Power-based training load (when you have a power meter)
units.does: Claims NP (Coggan 4th-power of 4-s rolling average), IF, power-TSS, VI computed when a power source and matching FTP exist.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Running FTP auto-estimator
units.does: Claims the running FTP estimator scans 90 days, requires 90% power coverage in a 20-minute window, FTP = best 20-min × 0.95, cached in UserDefaults, recomputed weekly, cleared when nothing qualifies. Verified lookbackDays 90, minimumPowerCoverage 0.9, twentyMinuteToFTPFactor 0.95 (FTPAutoEstimator.swift:44-50).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > One-shot load backfill
units.does: Claims WorkoutLoadBackfill runs weekly over 90 days applying RouteTRIMPEstimator to route-matching workouts, idempotent, re-running when saved-route count changes, with prior/outlier rules and replacement only when recorded TRIMP < half the estimate.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Turn-by-turn alerts (opt-in)
units.does: Claims two Notifications → Navigation toggles (turn-by-turn voice alerts at ~500 ft/~200 ft/at turn via TurnAlertEngine; turn-as-marker split recaps), both default off.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Validated physiology references
units.does: Lists cited references (Banister 1991, Rogers & Gronwald 2021, HRSS derivation, Friel LTHR, Strava DEM threshold — Emuqu uses 15 m).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Elevation accuracy — how Emuqu actually measures it
units.does: Claims headline elevation from barometer only: 15-sample symmetric moving average and 2 m hysteresis at stop; older recordings can query USGS NED 10 m / SRTM 30 m DEM with a 15 m sustained-climb threshold; per-split elevation from GPS altitude with same smoother. Verified BarometricAltitudeProcessor 15-sample window and 2.0 m threshold (BarometricAltitudeProcessor.swift:72-78), TopoElevationService.sustainedClimb.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Repairing α1 on historical walks
units.does: Claims a 'Re-analyze α1 for this session' button replays artifact filter + DFA on stored RR and writes corrected α1.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Fitness Tab > Data quality filters
units.does: Claims cadence caps 125 spm walk/hike, 220 run, 140 RPM bike and a tail-spike filter dropping trailing samples > 1.5× the trailing-30 median.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Home-screen Widget + Live Activity
units.does: Claims there is no home-screen widget or Live Activity.

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Apple Watch Companion App
units.does: Claims the Watch app mirrors the live workout, keeps an HKWorkoutSession alive without saving an HKWorkout, ends on its own after 30 minutes of phone silence or End while unreachable, and forwards wrist HR as fallback. Verified phoneSilenceLimit 30*60 (WatchMessageDecoding.swift:337).

units.key: § Emuqu User Manual > Apple Watch Companion App > Watch strap pairing
units.does: Claims WatchStrapConnector pairs a Polar or any HR Service (180D/2A37) device, persists the last peripheral in UserDefaults, pushes watchStrapSample to iOS, and the Watch does not request bluetooth-central background mode. Verified WKBackgroundModes lists only workout-processing (EmuquWatch Watch App/Info.plist:35-38).
